worker_output.summary: fix-77: The Ship_Power formula from design/technical/ai-implementation.md §1.3 was already implemented in strategies.ts. Updated diplomacyAI.ts to use getEmpireFleetPower() instead of getEmpireFleetSize() for proper military strength comparison. Added 13 comprehensive tests verifying the formula: HP component (Hull_HP × Armor_Multiplier × 0.5), weapon damage (Total × 2.0), shields (Shield_Class × 5), and speed (Speed × 3). Tests verify damage string parsing, armor multiplier lookup, HP-ratio adjustment for damaged ships, and the worked example from the design doc.

design_compliance.quote: Fleet_Power = Σ (Ship_Power × Ship_Count) for all ship designs

The Zortrium value also differs (2.0 in doc vs 1.8 in constants). This may be intentional game balance or needs review.
